items.name: init
items.title: Nizivo
items.description: Installs @nizivo/react and @nizivo/icons and adds components/nizivo/nizivo.css, which imports their stylesheet. Add it before any pattern.

items.name: analytics-page
items.title: Analytics page
items.description: A report inside the app shell, with a range control, key figures with sparklines, a sales trend, goals, sales by channel, orders per day and the top products.

items.name: collection-circles
items.title: Collection circles
items.description: A row of story-ring links to a store's collections, a cover in a ring and the name under it, that scrolls sideways. A server composition; it ships no JavaScript.

items.name: customer-card
items.title: Customer card
items.description: Who a customer is, what they are worth and how to reach them, an Avatar, their name and email, their orders and total spent, and their tags. A server composition; it ships no JavaScript.

items.name: customers-page
items.title: Customers page
items.description: A customer index inside the app shell, with key figures, segment links and a customers table beside the top cities and a win-back card. It ships no JavaScript.

items.name: discount-card
items.title: Discount card
items.description: A discount code, what it gives, its status, how much of it is used as a Meter and its dates, including an expired state that keeps its contrast. A server composition; it ships no JavaScript.

items.name: discounts-page
items.title: Discounts page
items.description: A discount index inside the app shell, with a notice, key figures, status links and a card per discount showing its status, dates and usage on a Meter. It ships no JavaScript.

items.name: onboarding-page
items.title: Onboarding page
items.description: A new store's home inside the app shell, with a setup checklist and its progress, an empty state for orders and next-step cards. It ships no JavaScript.

items.name: order-summary
items.title: Order summary
items.description: An order's lines and totals on a Card, the totals a description list with the amounts in tabular figures. A server composition; it ships no JavaScript.

items.name: order-table
items.title: Order table
items.description: An order list whose rows link to their orders, with the date, the customer, payment and fulfilment as two Badges with words, and the total. A server composition; it ships no JavaScript.

items.name: orders-page
items.title: Orders page
items.description: An order index inside the app shell, with key figures, status filters, search, an orders table and pagination; each order opens in a Drawer.

items.name: payment-method
items.title: Payment method
items.description: A choice of saved cards, one ChoiceCard of a native radio group each, the brand in words, the last four digits, the expiry spoken as a month and year, and the default marked with a Badge.

items.name: plan-billing-page
items.title: Plan and billing page
items.description: A settings page inside the app shell, with a section nav beside the current plan, its usage on Meters, the payment method, the invoices table and billing emails.

items.name: plan-card
items.title: Plan card
items.description: A subscription plan with its name, its price per interval, its features and a link to start, with a featured plan, and a row of plans with a monthly or yearly price.

items.name: product-card
items.title: Product card
items.description: A catalogue tile whose whole card links to the product, with a photo, the title, the price (and on a sale the price before it) and a status Badge. A server composition; it ships no JavaScript.

items.name: product-detail-page
items.title: Product detail page
items.description: A product's edit form inside the app shell, with a breadcrumb, media, details, variants and pricing beside its status, sales and inventory.

items.name: product-table
items.title: Product table
items.description: A catalogue table with row selection for bulk actions, a status Badge, the inventory and the price on each row, and a Menu of row actions named for its product.

items.name: product-tag
items.title: Product tag
items.description: Hotspots on a post's photo, each a named button that opens a Popover with the product's name, price and link.

items.name: products-page
items.title: Products page
items.description: A product index inside the app shell, with status filters, search, sort, a selectable product table and pagination.

items.name: shipment-tracker
items.title: Shipment tracker
items.description: A shipment's steps as an ordered list, the current one marked with aria-current="step" and every step's status said in words, a column on a narrow card and a row on a wide one. A server composition; it ships no JavaScript.

items.name: shoppable-post
items.title: Shoppable post
items.description: A post's media as one link, with a Shop badge that counts its tagged products and reads in both themes, alone and in the storefront's grid. A server composition; it ships no JavaScript.

items.name: storefront-bar
items.title: Storefront bar
items.description: The top of a store, with its Avatar, its name and Instagram link, its followers in compact notation, a Follow Button and the bag with its count.

items.name: tagged-product
items.title: Tagged product
items.description: The products in a post, each a row with a thumbnail, its name as a link, variant, price and a named add-to-bag IconButton.

items.name: variant-picker
items.title: Variant picker
items.description: A product's colour and size options as chips of native radios, with an out-of-stock option shown as sold out rather than disabled.

items.name: accordion-css
items.title: Accordion CSS
items.description: The Accordion stylesheet to own and edit (re-skin). Import components/nizivo/accordion-css.css instead of @nizivo/react/css/accordion.css (or after styles.css, where it wins by order within nz.components). Markup, classes, data attributes, behaviour and the base layer still come from npm.
